entries.zh: 浑然；浑然一体，全然相同（同样地）
entries.en: in one and the same manner; wholly, as one undivided whole
entries.notes: M 栏第二音拼写有疑（xzen/jen）；据汉字'渾然'与西语词头 de la mesma manera 定为'浑然一体/同样'义。

entries.zh: 浑成；浑然完整，天然浑成
entries.en: whole, complete; formed as one undivided whole
just like; exactly as, in the same manner as
entries.notes: 西语释义尾部与 M 栏末音残损（[残]）；据汉字'恰親像'与官话栏 qūi-chīn-chiāng 仍可定为'如同'义。

entries.zh: 片；薄的片状物（量词：一片）
entries.en: a thin flat piece, slice; (classifier) a countable thin thing
entries.notes: M 栏音写有疑（bỹ/bîy）；据汉字'片'与西语 delgada cosa numerada（可数的薄物）定为'薄片/量词'义。

entries.en: thin, flimsy (of things); slight

entries.zh: 薄（汉字栏疑有污损）；薄的东西
entries.en: thin, a thin thing (character column doubtful)
entries.notes: 汉字栏作'消'，与音写 pō/pog 不合，疑原字污损或误书；据西语 delgada cosa 与 M/R 音写 pō(pog) 定为'薄'义。

entries.zh: 不识立志，似为'不懂得立志'义；〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: lacking a set will / not knowing how to form a resolve (?); manuscript damaged, gloss uncertain
entries.notes: 官话栏空缺、西语与 M 栏残损，西语 'Demanda voluntad,? mala gana' 语义不明；仅据汉字'不識立志'与音写 m-bair-li̍k-chì 试释。

entries.en: to sue, bring a lawsuit; to litigate, dispute
moreover; besides this, furthermore
again; also, moreover
entries.notes: M 栏拼写有疑（un/in）；据汉字'又'与西语 Demas desto（除此之外）定为'又/再'义。

entries.en: manuscript damaged, gloss uncertain (only 'Dema: desto' legible in the Spanish column)
entries.notes: 汉字、官话两栏空缺，M 栏残损，仅西语存 'Dema: desto'（疑为 Demas desto 之残文），无从释义。

entries.zh: 妖；妖怪，怪物；魔鬼（endiablado：被魔缠附的）
entries.en: demon; monster, goblin; devilish, possessed
mountain demon (shanxiao); familiar spirit
tree spirit, wood demon
ghosts and monsters; demon
entries.notes: 西语词头残损（[残]）、官话栏第二音拼写有疑（caay/cuay）；据汉字'鬼怪'与音写 cuy-cuāy 仍可定为'鬼怪'义。

entries.en: evil spirit, demon; goblin, sprite
the devil, demon; evil spirit
entries.notes: 西语栏残损（'lian mo' 一语不明）；据汉字'魔鬼'与音写 mô-cui 定为'魔鬼'义。

entries.zh: 三魎（魈？）；山中鬼魅，作祟小妖
entries.en: a haunting imp / familiar demon (character uncertain: 魎/魈)
entries.notes: 汉字栏'魎/魈'二字有疑；据音写 sām-siāu 与西语 demonio familiar 释为山魈类鬼魅小妖。

entries.zh: 瘟鬼；散布瘟疫、祟害民众的疫鬼
entries.en: plague demon; pestilential ghost that infects the people
entries.notes: 西语释义尾部残损（[残]）；据汉字'瘟鬼'、音写 ūn-cui 与西语 apestado/inficiona el pueblo 定为'瘟鬼'义。

entries.en: demon, evil spirit (character order uncertain: 魈魔/鬼魔)
entries.notes: 汉字栏'魈魔/鬼魔'存疑；据音写 siāu-mô 以前者近是，义为邪魔鬼魅。
